beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps super-resolution dense by carrying features through encoder, windows, repeated shared DQ-CTM ticks, and decoder.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: ThinkSR separates the dense image field from the compact thought process that updates it. The encoder turns the low-resolution input into features before the thought process begins. Windowing divides those dense features without discarding the spatial carrier. DQ-CTM runs for repeated ticks while sharing the same parameters across ticks. The recurrence belongs to the thought stage itself, so the update repeats there. The decoder turns the updated dense carrier back into the super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier around a compact thought process
params.note: The recurrence returns to the thought stage, not the whole pipeline.

beats.intent: The carrier equation first makes a dense feature field, then partitions it into windows while preserving all tokens.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The equation defines the dense carrier before the compact thought process reads it. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into the feature field. The window partition converts that field into tokens while keeping every token available.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded first, then windowed without dropping tokens

terms.label: encoder maps the low-resolution image to features
window partition keeps every feature token

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the benchmark; its 1.129 million parameters are second largest among the five methods.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison does not support calling DQ-CTM-SR cheap. CATANet is the smallest model in this set. RFDN and IMDN remain below one million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR has one point one two nine million parameters, making it the second largest of the five. CARN is larger, but DQ-CTM-SR is still heavier than three baselines.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is the second largest model in this benchmark
